arStrings.szText: You have received the {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Talisman, 2} {c_highlight}Talisman{/c}, a Horadric relic of ancient power. Equip {c_highlight}Seals{/c} and {c_highlight}Charms{/c} to awaken the strength within.
{c_highlight}Horadric Seals{/c} unlock Charm slots within the Talisman. Each Seal carries unique power waiting to be unleashed.
{c_highlight}Horadric Charms{/c} hold power drawn from the Horadrim. Equip them to gain strength and {c_highlight}refine your build{/c}.
Some Charms belong to {c_highlight}Horadric Sets{/c}. Collect a full set to unlock their true power.
